_meta.description: Task C1 model display styling rules for tires.model_display. Each entry maps a (brand, model slug) pair from the tires table to its manufacturer-official display styling. Curated for the top ~100 models by row count plus the boss brands and majors (Michelin, Goodyear, Bridgestone, Continental, Toyo, Falken, Nexen, Kumho, Hankook). model_normalized is never changed by this styling; only the new model_display column is written.
_meta.brand_match: brand is matched case-insensitively against the tires.brand column value
_meta.slug_match: slug is matched exactly against the tires.model column value
